# NVIDIA Model Rankings: Free NIM API Models by Parameter Count

[![Validation](https://github.com/Yoosseph/nvidia-model-rankings/actions/workflows/update-models.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Yoosseph/nvidia-model-rankings/actions/workflows/update-models.yml) [![Models](https://img.shields.io/badge/active%20LLMs-39-76B900.svg)](#free-nvidia-nim-api-models-ranked-by-parameter-count) [![Last verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified-2026--11--04-blue.svg)](docs/methodology.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

**NVIDIA Model Rankings** compares **NVIDIA NIM API models** from [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com/models) by **total parameter count**. Find API model IDs, active parameters for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, context windows, endpoint status and source links in one independent catalog, with JSON and CSV downloads.

**[Browse the model rankings](https://yoosseph.github.io/nvidia-model-rankings/)** · [Download JSON](data/models.json) · [Download CSV](data/models.csv) · [Methodology](docs/methodology.md)

Free API access means NVIDIA's rate-limited trial for prototyping; quotas and availability can change. **Size is not a quality benchmark:** these rankings do not measure accuracy, speed or coding performance.

- **Models listed by the NVIDIA API (`/v1/models`):** 85
- **Active free-endpoint LLMs and VLMs:** 39
- **Deprecated but still listed:** 14 · **Listed without a model page:** 12
- **Largest active model:** **Mistral Large 4** (`mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b`, 1T total parameters)
- **Last verified:** 2026-11-04

> Data lives in [`data/models.json`](data/models.json) (also [`data/models.csv`](data/models.csv)). This README is generated by `scripts/generate_readme.py`. NVIDIA Model Rankings is a community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NVIDIA.

## Quick start: call a model with a free NVIDIA API key

1. Sign in at [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com/) and generate an API key (it starts with `nvapi-`).
2. Pick any **API model ID** from the tables below.
3. Call the OpenAI-compatible endpoint:

```bash
curl https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $NVIDIA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}], "max_tokens": 256}'
```

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1", api_key="nvapi-...")
reply = client.chat.completions.create(model="mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}])
print(reply.choices[0].message.content)
```

To list every model your key can see: `curl https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models`.

## FAQ

### Is the NVIDIA NIM API free?

Yes, for prototyping. A free NVIDIA Developer Program account lets you generate an API key for the hosted endpoints on build.nvidia.com. Access is a rate-limited trial governed by the NVIDIA API Trial Terms of Service and is not intended for production. Limits and terms can change, so check NVIDIA's terms before relying on them.

### What is the largest model available on build.nvidia.com?

As of 2026-11-04, the largest active model by total parameters is **Mistral Large 4** (`mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b`, 1T total parameters).

### What is the difference between total and active parameters?

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models activate only a subset of their weights per token. *Total* parameters measure the full model; *active* parameters approximate compute per token. This catalog ranks by total parameters.

### Is the largest NVIDIA API model the best model?

Not necessarily. Parameter count describes model size, not task quality, latency or cost. Compare models on your own workload and check the source model cards for evaluations.

### Why did DeepSeek-R1 / Qwen3-Coder / Llama 4 Maverick disappear?

They were absent from the API model list when last checked. A deprecation date is included only when NVIDIA published one. See [Recently removed models](#recently-removed-models).

### How often is the catalog updated?

Updates are maintainer-reviewed, not scheduled. Run `python scripts/update_models.py --check` at any time to compare the dataset with the live NVIDIA API. Every record shows its `last_verified` date.

## Use the dataset

- [JSON dataset](data/models.json): exact integer counts, API model IDs, source URLs and verification dates.
- [CSV dataset](data/models.csv): the same catalog for spreadsheets and analysis.
- [Removed model history](data/removed.json): models no longer returned by the API when checked.

The dataset and scripts are MIT licensed. To regenerate or validate the catalog locally, follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## How the data is verified

- **Availability:** the model ID must be returned by the official `/v1/models` endpoint. Deprecation dates and redirects are read from the model's build.nvidia.com page.
- **Parameters:** exact counts from the official unquantized Hugging Face checkpoint where available (`parameter_basis: checkpoint`). Otherwise, the figure stated on the NVIDIA model card or by the developer (`stated`). Counts are **never inferred from model names**. For example, Mixtral-8x22B has 141B parameters, not 176B.
- **Context length:** the maximum stated by the model card or checkpoint config. NVIDIA's hosted endpoint may serve a shorter window.

Full details are in [docs/methodology.md](docs/methodology.md). To contribute, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
